parts.text: Identify prime sailing regions for the month of January.

property.description: The response identifies multiple sailing regions suitable for the requested month.
The response is a valid JSON array of objects.
The response provides rich regional descriptions and sailing highlights for each recommended region.

parts.text: Identify prime sailing regions for the month of July.

property.description: The response identifies prime sailing regions suitable for July (such as the Mediterranean, New England, etc.).
The response is a valid JSON array of objects.

parts.text: Identify prime sailing regions for the month of October, highlighting shoulder-season synoptic windows, low-latitude cyclone-belt refuges, and high-energy tidal/wind passages.

property.description: Every returned region includes a non-empty 'deep_cut_reasoning' detailing specific synoptic wind regimes, seasonal arbitrage, and hydrographic/tidal pilotage characteristics.
The response is a valid JSON array of 8-12 non-overlapping region objects across at least 4 of the 5 tiers (including 'Classic Locale') and at least 3 macro-zones.
